target_customer: Large health systems (Cleveland Clinic is the named flagship customer); earlier, customer support teams using help desk software
problem: Operational work in health systems and support teams spans many systems with manual handoffs. Luminai records and replays workflows, using APIs where available and RPA style automation where not.
business_model: Enterprise B2B SaaS and automation platform sold to large organizations
product_category: Workflow automation and RPA, now AI for health system operations

founders.name: Kesava Kirupa Dinakaran
founders.background_notes: YC page says he survived off hackathon prize money and holds two Rubik's cube world records. TechCrunch says he and his co-founder met at a hackathon in May 2019.

founders.name: Dmitry Dolgopolov
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in TechCrunch coverage of the 2020 seed. Not listed on the current YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Recording user actions across arbitrary web apps and replaying them, with API detection and RPA fallback, is real engineering that two young founders built in 2020, but not research grade.

defensibility.rationale: At founding the product was a thin automation layer over Zendesk and similar tools, copyable by RPA vendors. Enterprise integrations in health systems later added switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found. The company stayed independent and moved from support automation to healthcare operations.

market_need_then: Support agents spent time on repetitive internal tasks such as cancelling orders or filing Jira tickets. TechCrunch (2020-10) reports the founders claim agents worked about twice as fast. No customer counts were given.

branding.domain_note: Moved to luminai.com at the June 2022 rebrand from DigitalBrain; how the domain was obtained was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise operations tone with quantified claims on the site

rebrands.why: Announced together with the Series A; TechCrunch reports the rename but the opened sources give no reason.

brand_strength.rationale: Press covers funding and the Cleveland Clinic partnership but nothing about the brand itself. The rename from a generic name to an invented one is a mild positive.

pivots.from: Customer service workflow automation layer on help desk tools (DigitalBrain)
pivots.to: General workflow automation under the Luminai name
AI platform for health system operations
pivots.why: Reported by one secondary summary as a rebuild around healthcare; date and reason unverified.

outcome_analysis: Luminai raised a 3.4 million dollar seed during YC, a 16 million dollar Series A led by General Catalyst in 2022 while keeping a lean team, and a 38 million dollar Series B in 2026 led by Peak XV with Cleveland Clinic as flagship customer. The move from support automation to healthcare operations gave it a high value enterprise niche. Total raised is stated as 60 million dollars by the company.
notes: Seed of 3.4M was assembled from 250K Unshackled Ventures (2020-03), 150K YC (2020-05) and about 3M led by Moxxie closed 2020-08 per TechCrunch. Series A date 2022-06-09 per TechCrunch; one aggregator says 2022-04. TechCrunch 2022 states almost 20M total raised. Series B total raised 60M per the company. Founding year 2019 per TechCrunch hackathon meeting and aggregators; the YC page says 2020. The 2020 TechCrunch piece names Zendesk and Jira only as platforms it integrates with, no direct competitors, so the competitor list is empty. Co-founder Dolgopolov comes from TechCrunch, not the YC page. The Series A blog URL returned 404.
